text.en: Dpm-solver is row 91 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Diffusion Model Application area.
text.zh: Dpm-solver 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 91 行，所属领域为“扩散模型应用”。

text.en: The annual table associates Dpm-solver with “Dpm-solver: A fast ode solver for diffusion probabilistic model sampling in around 10 steps”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Dpm-solver 与论文《Dpm-solver: A fast ode solver for diffusion probabilistic model sampling in around 10 steps》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Cheng Lu, Jianfei Chen, Jun Zhu”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Cheng Lu（官方页拼写）、Jianfei Chen（官方页拼写）、Jun Zhu（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Cheng Lu, Jianfei Chen, Jun Zhu”。
